artigo.titulo: Why is my poinsettia dropping leaves?

legenda: A poinsettia dropping leaves is reacting to something that changed. Cold draughts, soggy or bone-dry compost and low light are the usual causes.

beats.texto: Don't panic! It's not giving up.
Sudden wilting after a cold night?! It got a chill.
Keep it away from cold glass and open doors.
Yellow lower leaves and damp compost?! Too much water.
Take off the foil sleeve so it can drain.
Curled leaves and dry compost?! It's thirsty.
So check the compost first, then water well.
Every spot is different. There's an app that tells you when.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
